title.narrative: CD Finance Management Expanding Access to Finance for Farmers and Microentrepreneurs Project

description.narrative: The project entails the Asian Development Bank (ADB) providing longer-tenor financing to CFM to support the company's lending operations to farmers and micro entrepreneurs in PRC's rural counties. The proposed loan will help expand the availability of microcredit to the underserved segments, including women borrowers, and support rural economic development
